title: Racing
content:
# Racing

Chippenham and District Wheelers provide opportunities to race in time trials, open and club events, track racing and road racing. Riders do not need a specialist time-trial bike to take part in club time trials.

## Racing Quick Access

- [Courses](/racing/chippenham-wheelers-time-trial-course-maps/)
- [Annual time trials](/2025-time-trials/)
- [Trophies and awards](/trophies-and-awards/)
- [Club records](/racing/chippenham-wheelers-time-trial-records/)

## Cycling Time Trials

The club is affiliated to the [Cycling Time Trials organisation](https://www.cyclingtimetrials.org.uk/) and events are organised under its regulations. Riders must wear a helmet and have working front and rear lights where required.

## Western District Time Trials

The club is part of the [Western District](https://west.ctt.org.uk/) of Cycling Time Trials and its events are approved by the district.

## Western Time Trial Association

The club participates in the [Western Time Trial Association](http://www.wtta-hardriders.org.uk/) Hardrider series.

## What Are Time Trials?

A time trial is a race against the clock, with riders starting at intervals. It is a simple and accessible form of competitive cycling.

## Club Evening Time Trials

See the [club calendar](/club-calendar/) for current dates and the [club competitions](/club-time-trial-competitions/) page for historical information.

## Results and Records

Browse [results](/our-news/), [club trophies](/trophies-and-awards/) and [club records](/racing/chippenham-wheelers-time-trial-records/). External reports and historic documents remain linked where they are the authoritative source.
